policy: Read only the public task prompt and exact generated response. Determine whether one complete answer is unambiguously expressible without changing values or units. Preserve all supplied points, duplicates, and order. Do not inspect images, labels, manifests, scores, other records, memory, network, or model APIs. Do not infer centers from bounding boxes, select subsets, repair missing values, or assess correctness.

items.prompt:
Solve this visual puzzle. You may reason before answering, but provide one complete final answer. No actions are executed and no additional observations are available.

Identify all actually visible eyes of the robot. Include one point per visible eye; do not include hidden eyes. Order does not matter.

Input dimensions: image 1: 1024x1024 pixels
Coordinates use the top-left origin: x increases rightward and y downward.
Final answer: All eye-center coordinates in pixels as [(x1, y1), (x2, y2), ...]. Order does not matter. Include only actually visible eyes of the requested target.
Put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.
